verdict.rationale: Synthesia documents a real API surface. It includes a Video API for scripted avatar videos, dubbing, translation and templates; an Upload API for assets; a Billing API; completion webhooks; and an Interactive Avatars API. Many UI-documented features have no evidenced API equivalent, so full parity is not shown. Those features include prompt/link/PPT-to-video via the AI Assistant, photo-based avatar creation, outfit/background changes, branching and quizzes, roleplay assignment and scoring, collaborative review, screen recording, brand kits, and SCORM export. Missing for 10: API coverage for avatar creation, PPT/prompt-to-video, interactive branching/quizzes, roleplay, collaboration/review workflows, brand kit management, and SCORM export, plus any explicit parity statement or independent corroboration.
